description: Send a signed invoice to ZATCA's Fatoora API using the configured CSID: "report" (simplified/B2C), "clear" (standard/B2B, returns the stamped invoice) or "compliance" (onboarding checks). Uses ZATCA_ENV (sandbox by default). Production submissions are real tax filings and require ZATCA_ALLOW_PRODUCTION=1.
name: submit_invoice
title: Submit an invoice to ZATCA
